title: Contraction reduces the vertex count by one
statement:
Let $G$ be a multigraph and let $e$ be an edge of $G$ that is not a self-loop, so that its two endpoints are distinct. Writing $G/e$ for the multigraph obtained by contracting $e$, its vertex count satisfies
\[
  \abs{V(G/e)} = \abs{V(G)} - 1,
\]
where the subtraction is truncated at $0$.
hypotheses_covered: e is an edge of G (e ∈ E(G))
e is not a self-loop (not a diagonal pair)
replaced:
If $e \in E(G)$ is not a diagonal (self-loop) pair, then
\[
  \abs{V(G/e)} = \abs{V(G)} - 1 .
\]
